ns2:course.label: Junior Gies Scholar Seminar
ns2:course.description: Focuses on expanding students' knowledge about higher education and the academy through the depth and breadth of University of Illinois faculty expertise. Each week, an invited faculty member will give a brief presentation on their research or area of expertise and lead an interactive discussion session with the students. Prerequisite: Third-year student in the Gies Scholar Program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Third-year student in the Gies Scholar Program.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s).
